lines.t: Your voice, Lord, you stir my soul
You light my soul on fire
A love which this world has not known
Why, oh Lord, do you bless me so?
I have sinned greatly in my life
And desecrate your name in this temple you gave me
Why oh Lord do you bless me so
What have I done to deserve such mercy
Such overwhelming love in your presence
You are my Lord and my God, my
Why, oh Lord, do you bless me so?
You are my Lord and my God, my life
